keyEvents.text: Goal! Swansea City 1, Blackburn Rovers 0. Stephen Eustaquio (Swansea City) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Joseph Opoku with a cross.
Moussa Baradji (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Harry Pickering (Blackburn Rovers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Gady Beyuku replaces Harry Pickering because of an injury.
Goal! Swansea City 2, Blackburn Rovers 0. Joseph Opoku (Swansea City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Swansea City 3, Blackburn Rovers 0. Filip Lissah (Swansea City) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Stephen Welsh.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Augustus Kargbo replaces Jayden Fevrier.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Hayden Carter replaces Tom Atcheson.
Delay in match (Swansea City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Swansea City 4, Blackburn Rovers 0. Ross Stewart (Swansea City) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Eom Ji-Sung.
Substitution, Swansea City. Zan Vipotnik replaces Ross Stewart.
Substitution, Swansea City. Gonçalo Franco replaces Melker Widell.
Delay in match because of an injury Stephen Eustaquio (Swansea City).
Substitution, Swansea City. Tiago Parente replaces Josh Tymon.
Substitution, Swansea City. Adam Idah replaces Stephen Eustaquio because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Swansea City. Joshua Key replaces Filip Lissah.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Yuki Ohashi replaces Andri Gudjohnsen.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Yuri Ribeiro replaces Moussa Baradji.
